bug_semantics: irdma_copy_user_pgaddrs walks every ib_umem DMA block and writes each address through *pbl, advancing the pointer with irdma_next_pbl_addr. The only explicit cap is if (++pbl_cnt == palloc->total_cnt) break. irdma_setup_pbles with lvl/use_pbles==0 skips irdma_get_pble, leaves the kzalloc-zeroed palloc->total_cnt at 0, and aims pbl at the 4-slot iwmr->pgaddrmem array (IRDMA_MAX_SAVED_PHY_PGADDR). Because pbl_cnt is pre-incremented from 0, it never equals total_cnt==0, so the loop continues until the umem is exhausted and writes attacker-controlled DMA addresses past pgaddrmem[4] into adjacent irdma_mr/iwpbl heap fields. For QP/CQ/SRQ, lvl is derived from a separate udata field (e.g. req.cq_pages > 1), so a local uverbs irdma_reg_user_mr caller can request the lvl==0 path while supplying a umem with more DMA blocks than the 4-entry array.
flaw_origin: The flawed bound was first written when the irdma verbs implementation was added in b48c24c2d710. That commit created drivers/infiniband/hw/irdma/verbs.c with irdma_copy_user_pgaddrs using rdma_umem_for_each_dma_block plus the total_cnt equality break, and irdma_setup_pbles routing the non-PBLE path to iwmr->pgaddrmem without giving the copier a real length. Later edits only retargeted sg_page (79fbd3e1241c) or renamed use_pbles to lvl (cc8997c94bf3); they did not introduce the overflow. git -C/-M does not treat verbs.c as a rename of i40iw_verbs.c; i40iw had an unbounded DMA-block walk but not this total_cnt==0 cap.

reasoning: CVE-2026-74390 is a published Linux CNA record (not withdrawn/rejected) for an out-of-bounds write in irdma_copy_user_pgaddrs. A local user who can open uverbs registers a CQ/QP/SRQ MR whose udata page-count keeps irdma_setup_pbles on the lvl==0 path (pbl = iwmr->pgaddrmem[4]) while the umem contains more DMA blocks than that array. palloc->total_cnt stays 0, so the equality cap never fires and DMA addresses are written past the array into adjacent heap metadata. Independent git log -L/-S and parent-tree checks show that exact mechanism was first written in b48c24c2d710 when verbs.c was added; the parent lacks the file and the function; later lvl rename and sg_table retargets are not BICs; the commit is a ordinary single-parent patch, not a squash/move. Mainline fix 5ebb3ed757be (and its stable backports) is the first commit that gives the copier an explicit pbl_len, including IRDMA_MAX_SAVED_PHY_PGADDR for lvl==0. BIC precedes v5.14 and the fix lands in v7.2-rc1 / listed stable tags, matching the CVE affected/fixed ranges.
